intent.proves: Fields that differ per language or per variant: one-language-no-variant satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ProductLanguageId) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM EcomProducts) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts WHERE ISNULL(ProductVariantId, N'') <> N'')
